hook: Stop steering Claude Code so much.

beats.say: The latest models, like Opus five point five and Fable five point two, are much more autonomous, so too much steering can do more harm than good.
Use auto approval by default, clearly specify the deny rules, and give Claude a clear definition of done for the task.
Add a separate reviewer agent to verify the results, and use Advisor to optimise model usage, since Medium effort gives the best Opus five point five performance without draining the token limit.
